title: Animus NPC definition
description: npcs/<folders>/<id>.json, in npcs/ itself or up to 8 folders deep. Unknown fields and modules are kept as written.

uuid.description: A canonical lowercase UUID that never changes.

group.description: The folder under npcs/, empty for npcs/ itself. Animus sets it from where the file is.

type.description: An entity type such as minecraft:player. The examples are the bodies every transport draws.

owner.description: The owning player's UUID, canonical and lowercase. Modules may use it for their own permission rules.

skin.description: SHA-256 of a skin document under skins/.

equipment.description: Items the body wears and holds, by slot.

pose.description: The body pose. Only standing applies to bodies other than minecraft:player.

hologram.description: Text lines above the body. & colour codes such as &a are drawn in colour.

anyOf.description: A line with extra space above or below it.

marginTop.description: Blocks of space above the line.

marginBottom.description: Blocks of space below the line.

lineHeight.description: Blocks between lines; gives each line its own display.

viewRange.description: Blocks from which the text is seen.

billboard.description: How the text turns toward the viewer. center by default.

shadowed.description: Draw a shadow under the text.

interpolationDelay.description: Ticks before a change starts to animate.

interpolationDuration.description: Ticks a change takes to animate.

nameplate.description: Whether the name shows above the body.

armorStand.description: minecraft:armor_stand bodies only: parts shown and pose angles in degrees.

basePlate.description: Show the base plate. True by default.

invisible.description: Hide the stand and show only what it wears.

head.description: [x, y, z] degrees; omit for the default pose.

body.description: [x, y, z] degrees; omit for the default pose.

leftArm.description: [x, y, z] degrees; omit for the default pose.

rightArm.description: [x, y, z] degrees; omit for the default pose.

leftLeg.description: [x, y, z] degrees; omit for the default pose.

rightLeg.description: [x, y, z] degrees; omit for the default pose.

glowing.description: An outline glow in the team colour.

teamColor.description: The colour of the glow and the name.

baby.description: A baby body, for types that have one.

listed.description: Player bodies only: show an entry in the tab list.

gravity.description: False keeps the body where it is placed. True by default.

inventory.description: A stored inventory for behaviors and modules to read. Nothing draws it.

size.description: Slots: a multiple of 9 up to 72.

slots.description: Items by slot number from 0, each inside size.

poses.description: Named look directions the animus:pose action turns to. They change where the NPC looks, never its body pose.

movement.description: How this NPC walks wherever it walks. A route's own speed wins over speed.

avoidWater.description: False lets a walking route cross water at the surface. True by default.

openDoors.description: Walk through wooden doors, fence gates and trapdoors, closing them behind.

stepHeight.description: Blocks the body climbs without jumping.

pathRange.description: Blocks one plan reaches; longer legs walk in segments.

arrivalMargin.description: Blocks from a point that count as reaching it.

stuck.description: What an NPC that has stopped getting closer does.

teleport.description: Teleport to the point; false stops instead. True by default.

behaviors.description: Behaviors whose triggers this NPC runs.

tags.description: Labels for finding and grouping NPCs in the editor; at most 32.

groups.description: Trait groups under groups/ whose values this NPC takes, in merge order; the NPC's own fields win.

rig.description: The rig under rigs/ this NPC's body shows.

modules.description: Per-NPC module settings, keyed by namespace:name. Unknown modules are kept.

animus:navigation.description: Native waypoints, or a reusable route under routes/.

recording.description: A recording under recordings/ to play instead of a route.

playback.description: Recording only: once, loop (the default) or pingpong.

mode.description: walk by default. Walking points stand on whole-block heights.

order.description: How the next point is chosen. sequence by default.

loop.description: Order sequence only: start again from the first point.

oneOf.description: [min, max] in ticks, min not above max.

waitTicks.description: Wait before the first leg and after each arrival: ticks, or [min, max] drawn per arrival.

seed.description: npc (default): choices stable per NPC and route, across restarts. random: mixed with the clock.

startOffset.description: random: start at a random point after a random 0..waitTicks wait. first by default.

jitter.description: Leg goals move by a random whole-block x/z offset within this radius.

points.description: Route points in the NPC's world, or recording steps; wander centres for order wander.

oneOf.description: [min, max] in ticks, min not above max.

waitTicks.description: Wait after arriving here, instead of the route's.

jitter.description: Jitter radius of this point, instead of the route's.

weight.description: Order random only: how often this point is chosen.

next.description: Order sequence only: after this point, the next point is drawn from these by weight.

oneOf.description: A recording step: walk to the segment's first frame, play it once, then go on from its last frame.

fromTick.description: First tick of the segment, 0 by default; below toTick.

toTick.description: Last tick of the segment; the recording's durationTicks by default.

playback.description: A step plays once; loop and pingpong are refused because the route must go on.

oneOf.description: [min, max] in ticks, min not above max.

waitTicks.description: Wait after arriving here, instead of the route's.

weight.description: Order random only: how often this point is chosen.

next.description: Order sequence only: after this point, the next point is drawn from these by weight.

guides.description: Order random only: helper nodes a path may pass through.

linkDistance.description: Order random only: the longest link between two nodes.

height.description: Blocks up or down from a centre.

animus:combat.description: Fighting, guarding, health and death. An unknown setting is refused so a typo cannot weaken a rule.

enabled.description: Literal true turns combat on; anything else leaves it off.

reviewAccepted.description: Imported NPCs fight only once this is literal true.

ignores.description: Who the NPC never attacks, even when a target rule matches.

avoids.description: Who the NPC keeps away from.

name.description: NPCs of one squad alert each other.

npc.description: Guard this NPC, by its uuid.

assist.description: Attack whatever the guarded player or NPC attacks.

catchUpDistance.description: Teleport near the charge beyond this; 0 never teleports. 24 by default.

region.description: A protection region the fight stays inside.

weaponDamage.description: Damage by held item id, at most 64.

effect.description: Potion only: the effect it applies.

deleteOnDeath.description: Delete the definition on death; needs delayTicks -1.

friendly.description: Said to players it would not target.

hostile.description: Said to players it would target.

targetableByMobs.description: Nearby hostile mobs may attack the NPC.

animus:shop.description: The shop a click opens. A sneaking administrator selects the NPC instead.

shop.description: A shop id such as town:baker.

openOn.description: Which click opens it. right by default.

reviewAccepted.description: An imported binding opens nothing until this is true.

animus:gui.description: A chest GUI, menu, shop or Gloss menu a click opens, and a hologram that follows the NPC.

id.description: An id such as town:menu, or a Gloss menu path such as lobby/main.

openOn.description: Which click opens it. right by default.

id.description: A hologram id such as town:sign.

offset.description: [x, y, z] blocks from the NPC's feet; omit to sit above its head.

animus:hire.description: Hiring this NPC as a bodyguard: the price, the items and how long one hire lasts.

enabled.description: False turns hiring off and keeps the terms.

items.description: Items one hire costs, at most 6.

durationMinutes.description: 60 by default; a renewal adds the same again.

permission.description: A permission node the hirer must hold.

animus:riding.description: Lets a real player ride this NPC.

animus:look-close.description: Turns the NPC toward the nearest player in range while it is spawned.

enabled.description: True when the object is present.

lineOfSight.description: Only look at players it can see.

whileNavigating.description: Also look while following a route.

npcs.description: Also look at the nearest other NPC when no player is in range.

randomLook.description: With nobody to look at, turn to a random facing every delayTicks.

delayTicks.description: Ticks between random turns. 60 by default.

yaw.description: [minimum, maximum] yaw in degrees. [0, 360] by default.

pitch.description: [minimum, maximum] pitch in degrees. [0, 0] by default.

item.description: An item: its id, a count and the component text of a give command.

components.description: Text after the item id in a give command, such as [enchantment_glint_override=true].

imported.description: Source item data from an import, kept and never interpreted.

categories.description: players, npcs, mobs, monsters or animals.

all.description: Rule sets that must all match one entity.

together.description: Groups of 2 to 8 rule sets matched by entities near each other.

chat.description: Words in chat that make the speaker a target.
